{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow uses actions that are not certified by GitHub.
# They are provided by a third-party and are governed by
# separate terms of service, privacy policy, and support
# documentation.

name: test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - lib/**
      - test/**
      - pubspec.yaml
      - pubspec.lock

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Note: This workflow uses the latest stable version of the Dart SDK.
      # You can specify other versions if desired, see documentation here:
      # https://github.com/dart-lang/setup-dart/blob/main/README.md
      # - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      - name: Setup Java JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 17
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          cache: true
          flutter-version-file: pubspec.yaml

      - name: Cache Dart pub dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pub-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pub-

      # Uncomment this step to verify the use of 'dart format' on each commit.
      # - name: Verify formatting
      #   run: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .

      # Consider passing '--fatal-infos' for slightly stricter analysis.
      - name: pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: dart run build_runner
        run: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs

      - name: Create files
        env:
          FIREBASE_OPTIONS: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_OPTIONS }}
        run: |
          echo $FIREBASE_OPTIONS | base64 -d > lib/firebase_options.dart
      # Your project will need to have tests in test/ and a dependency on
      # package:test for this step to succeed. Note that Flutter projects will
      # want to change this to 'flutter test'.
      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `flutter pub get` on every pull request but only caches the Flutter SDK (via subosito/flutter-action cache: true), not the Dart pub dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern supports caching dependency downloads keyed on the lockfile (pubspec.lock) while keeping installation and all required tests. Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for ~/.pub-cache before pub get is minimal, preserves every build/test step and coverage, uses an official GitHub action, and introduces no new secrets, privileged actions, deployment/publishing operations, or new network access. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs on each PR, the cache key includes the lockfile and runner OS, and no equivalent pub-cache cache already exists.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

# This workflow uses actions that are not certified by GitHub.
# They are provided by a third-party and are governed by
# separate terms of service, privacy policy, and support
# documentation.

name: test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - lib/**
      - test/**
      - pubspec.yaml
      - pubspec.lock

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Note: This workflow uses the latest stable version of the Dart SDK.
      # You can specify other versions if desired, see documentation here:
      # https://github.com/dart-lang/setup-dart/blob/main/README.md
      # - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      - name: Setup Java JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: 17
          distribution: temurin

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          cache: true
          flutter-version-file: pubspec.yaml

      - name: Cache Dart pub dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pub-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pub-

      # Uncomment this step to verify the use of 'dart format' on each commit.
      # - name: Verify formatting
      #   run: dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .

      # Consider passing '--fatal-infos' for slightly stricter analysis.
      - name: pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: dart run build_runner
        run: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs

      - name: Create files
        env:
          FIREBASE_OPTIONS: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_OPTIONS }}
        run: |
          echo $FIREBASE_OPTIONS | base64 -d > lib/firebase_options.dart
      # Your project will need to have tests in test/ and a dependency on
      # package:test for this step to succeed. Note that Flutter projects will
      # want to change this to 'flutter test'.
      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test
